contract: Descriptive personal scorecards project canonical human goal plans, measurement corrections, unit-separated laboratory series and actual intervention observations. No composite health score, causal inference or private twin fields. User-authored narratives carry immutable source snapshots in canonical artifact versions; source fingerprint and version conflicts prevent stale overwrite. Narrative creation is content-idempotent.
acceptance: Actual goal checkins and milestones, measurement corrections, lab source artifacts and missing intervention observations project without invented metrics.
Artifact versions retain old source revisions and notes; stale fingerprints/versions and unrelated artifact edits are rejected.
Authenticated HTTP and native read return same actual records; console creates and revises actual artifacts and loads history through real HTTP.
limitations: Narratives are user-authored; automated model synthesis and semantic quality are not claimed.
Measurement and lab series are bounded to latest 500 records, goals and active interventions to 200; reach-limit coverage is explicit.

qualification.stages: Compile and runtime retained from repair1; UI-only repair2 passed. Automated synthesis unimplemented, user-authored source-linked narratives qualified.
